"[project]/.next-test-class-callables192-observer10-local-arrows-development/subject.ts [next-test-node] (ecmascript)", ((__turbopack_context__) => {
"use strict";

__turbopack_context__.s([
    "Counter",
    ()=>Counter,
    "exercise",
    ()=>exercise
]);
const offset = 2;
function prefix(value) {
    return value + 1;
}
class Counter {
    constructor(value){
        this.total = value;
    }
    read = (delta)=>this.total + delta;
    static combine = (value)=>value * 2;
    method(delta) {
        return this.total + delta;
    }
}
function exercise(value) {
    const counter = new Counter(prefix(value));
    return counter.read(offset) + Counter.combine(value) + counter.method(offset);
}
}),
